description: Chaiz is the first online marketplace for vehicle service contracts (extended car warranties), and this app brings it into ChatGPT. A vehicle service contract picks up after your factory warranty ends and covers major mechanical repairs, so you pay your deductible instead of the full repair bill. Tell Chaiz your car by VIN, license plate, or make, model, and year, plus your mileage and state, and it pulls live quotes from multiple trusted providers so you can compare real prices, coverage, and independent plan ratings side by side. No sales calls, no waiting for a callback, and no handing over your phone number or email just to see a price. When you find a plan you like, Chaiz links you to chaiz.com to read the full contract and check out online.
